title: Sell a minimum amount of biobased petrol
what: Sell at least the minimum amount of sustainable biobased petrol (ethanol blends) each quarter, as a liable fuel seller.

sources.title: Liquid Fuel Supply Act 1984 (Qld)
sources.quote: A fuel seller must sell at least the minimum amount of sustainable biobased petrol in each calendar quarter
